content.description: A brown-black tabby cat stands in bright snow, body in side profile with head turned toward the camera. It has upright ears, yellow-green eyes, pink nose, white muzzle/chest, striped legs, and a long ringed tail extended behind. One front paw is lifted with snow visible on the paw; the background is a blurred snowy field with pale tree shapes. Breed, sex, and age are uncertain.
